title: Architecture-log row fragment
description: Per-chunk fragment containing exactly ONE markdown table row destined for `.kaizen/workflow/progress.md`. The MERGE step concatenates these in chunk-id order. Validated as a string matching the canonical row shape.

row.description: Single-line table row: `| YYYY-MM-DD | <kind> | +X -Y | <one-line summary> |`. The MERGE step appends one such row per fragment to .kaizen/workflow/progress.md.
